source_caption_text:
BenDaDonnn Breaks Down What It Felt Like Getting Tased For The First Time By A Bike Cop After The Texas A&M College Football Game 😭

BenDaDonnn is a popular comedian, content creator and livestreamer whose real name is Benjamin “Benius” Beard. He’s known for his high-energy personality, comedy, collaborations with athletes and entertainers, and livestream content. He has built a large following across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Twitch. 

BenDaDonnn was arrested in College Station, Texas, early October 4 following the Texas A&M vs. Arkansas football game. According to College Station police, officers were clearing people from the roadway outside a Northgate bar when a group allegedly refused repeated commands to move. Police say that while officers were attempting to detain BenDaDonnn, he tried to get away, leading an officer to use a Taser before taking him into custody. He was charged with evading arrest or detention, booked into Brazos County Jail with a reported $7,000 bond, and was later released on bond. 

His security guard, Kenny Carter, was also arrested and charged with interference with public duties after police alleged he physically interfered while officers were making the arrest. These are allegations/charges, and the case had not yet been resolved in court as of the latest reporting.
